entities.summary: Erick Thohir is an Indonesian businessman and politician who served as Minister of State Owned Enterprises and later serving as Minister of Youth and Sports in President Prabowo Subianto's Red and White Cabinet. He has been the chairman of Football Association of Indonesia since 2023 and founder of Mahaka Group, a conglomeration that focuses on media, sports and entertainment. The former owner and chairman of Italian football giant Inter Milan and US soccer club D.C. United, Thohir is currently owner of the English Championship team Oxford United, and the Indonesian Liga 1 team Persis Solo alongside Kaesang Pangarep, youngest son of the former President Joko Widodo.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent businessman and politician in Indonesia, Erick Thohir has had significant regional impact through his roles as Minister of State Owned Enterprises and Minister of Youth and Sports, shaping the country's sports and media landscape.
